name: dsh-mobile-link
description: Phone pairing for DeepSeek Harness: three values (relay, room, key) bind a phone to this desktop, then the phone can read and continue the desktop's sessions. Works out of the box on the same LAN; across networks the plugin brings up its own tunnel (downloading the binary itself) or a fingerprint-pinned direct HTTPS endpoint, with the payloads encrypted end to end so the middle hop only sees ciphertext. 三项值（中继 / 房间号 / 口令）把手机与电脑配对，手机可读取并续接电脑上的会话；同一局域网开箱即用，跨网由插件自己拉起隧道或直接连（端到端加密，中间层只见密文），不需要用户跑任何命令。

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check relay/server.mjs && node --check e2e.mjs && node --check rpc.mjs && node --check direct.mjs && node --check tunnel.mjs
